scientific_integrity: The analytical proof supplies continuum classifications; no finite experiment is represented as proof of universal quantification. Cube endpoint was previously known and is not a novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Haar-uniform central sections only; c in (1,3). Individual nonquadrilateral probabilities have only c→2 asymptotics. Exceptional planes have measure zero, numerical checks are corroborative, historical priority is provisional, independent validation unperformed.
title: Haar octagon rigidity and asymmetric section-type breakdown at the cuboctahedron
